description: Build Globestudio URLs for a customized globe. Start from a preset (look) or change an existing link (share_url, e.g. one the user pasted): pass only the settings to change and everything else in the link is kept. Returns share_url (opens the studio with those settings) and embed_url (the bare canvas, for iframes).

config.description: Any other setting, using the keys read_share_url returns in config, e.g. {"viewMode": "flat"} or {"globeSettings": {"autoSpin": false}}. Nested settings merge key by key; keys Globestudio does not accept come back in ignored. With "v": 3, as read_share_url returns for a link that has it, its colors render as their hex; without it they render darker, as in links before v3.

look.description: Preset id, e.g. 'halftone'. Required unless share_url is given.

selection.description: Region: 'world' (default), ISO country code ('JP' or 'JPN'), country name ('Japan'), continent ('Europe'), or subregion ('Western Europe').

share_url.description: A Globestudio link to change instead of starting from a preset.

name: build_share_url
title: Build a share link
